newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher despite strong sterling.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher despite strong sterling.

text.p: UK shares opened modestly higher on Monday, led by a strong pharmaceuticals sector and supported by gilts, but gains were seen limited as the pound hovered above three marks, its highest level for 6-1/2 years.
"People will be dwelling on sterling's rise over three marks," said one equity salesman. "There is potential for volatility."
The FTSE 100 index was up seven points at 4,806.5 by 0753 GMT after halving opening gains led by weakening futures. Decliners and advancers were roughly evenly matched.
